payout_quote: Earn Up TO $200 New Member Bonus. 1. Open a Momentum+ Rewards Checking and Savings account. 2. Set up monthly direct deposit. 3. Hit your deposit tier for 3 months. Your new member bonus is paid automatically; no extra action required. Direct Deposit Bonus Tiers: $600/month - $50 bonus; $1,500/month - $100 bonus; $3,000/month - $150 bonus; $5,000/month - $200 bonus. No points. No conversions. Just real cash.
steps: Open both a Momentum+ Rewards Checking account and a Momentum+ Rewards Savings account.
Set up a qualifying monthly direct deposit (payroll, pension, or government benefits).
Hit your direct-deposit tier for 3 consecutive months ($600/mo for $50, $1,500/mo for $100, $3,000/mo for $150, $5,000/mo for $200).
Bonus is paid automatically once the tier is held for 3 months.
catches: Tiered payout: the full $200 requires $5,000/month in direct deposits for 3 months; $600/month earns only $50.
Requires opening BOTH a checking and a savings account, and both must be open and in good standing when the bonus is paid.
A $9.99 monthly maintenance fee applies unless monthly direct deposits exceed $600.
Bonus eligibility is based on qualifying direct deposits during the third full month-end cycle after account opening; paid the following month.
Qualifying direct deposits exclude P2P payments (Zelle, Cash App, PayPal, Venmo), transfers, and self-made deposits.
Membership limited to select Texas counties (Dallas, Collin, Rockwall area); membership eligibility required.
The bonus is generally treated as taxable dividend income (typically reported on Form 1099-INT); consult a tax advisor - general bank-bonus tax treatment, not stated in the captured official terms.
Limit one bonus per membership; not available for account conversions; members who had a checking account within the past 12 months may not qualify.
No stated expiry - offer subject to change at any time.
biggest_catch: The headline $200 requires $5,000/month in direct deposits sustained for 3 months; most people will land in the $50-$100 tiers, and a $9.99 monthly fee applies if deposits stay under $600.
eligibility: New members in America's Credit Union's Texas field of membership (Dallas, Collin, Rockwall counties area) who open Momentum+ Rewards Checking + Savings; no checking account with the CU in the past 12 months.
timing: Bonus credited the month after the third full month-end cycle in which the direct-deposit tier is met.
weasel_words: Up TO $200 - tiered payout; actual bonus depends on direct-deposit tier
